affected_boundaries: worker delivery evidence to whole-plan lifecycle and integration

observed_behavior: A completed worker could not become merge-ready until its whole plan was closed, although final acceptance required the worker commit in the integrated tree.
expected_behavior: Exact worker delivery evidence permits integration while the plan remains active, and successful final integrated acceptance permits closure and cleanup.
causal_mechanism: The worker evidenceComplete flag was derived from the plan's successful-completion lifecycle instead of an independently recorded revision and evidence set.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A parent lifecycle outcome is reused as proof for an earlier child-delivery transition.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The earlier transition becomes dependent on a later acceptance outcome, producing a lifecycle cycle and encouraging premature closure.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Each transition is authorized by its own evidence, and final lifecycle completion follows validation of the integrated result.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Persist an authenticated clean revision and committed evidence paths, integrate that delivery, retain MERGED while active, and unlock cleanup only after plan closure.

applicability_conditions: Final acceptance must evaluate a combined or integrated tree after an independently produced delivery.
known_non_matches: A standalone change whose complete acceptance can be established entirely inside its one checkout has no separate integration gate.
confirmation_evidence: The focused regression reaches READY_TO_MERGE and MERGED while active, remains retained, then becomes cleanup-eligible only after closure.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: verified worker delivery integrates before plan closure and cleanup waits for closure
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: worker delivery accepts only an exact clean revision with committed evidence
